title: Federal FOIA in Delaware public records context
text: All requests for inspection of public records held by a Delaware public body shall be processed under the federal Freedom of Information Act, 5 U.S.C. § 552.

should_error.reason: Federal FOIA should not be used for Delaware public records.

should_warn.reason: Expected warning suggesting Delaware FOIA, 29 Del. C. ch. 100.

title: Federal regulation coverage boundary
text: The medical device manufacturer shall comply with FDA quality system regulations under 21 C.F.R. Part 820.

title: Federal estate tax boundary in trust context
text: Delaware trust law alone determines all estate-tax, gift-tax, GST-tax, income-tax, IRA, 401(k), and ERISA beneficiary consequences without any need for federal law analysis.

should_warn.reason: Federal tax law (estate/gift/GST/income) and ERISA are federal matters outside Delaware Code coverage.

title: Probate court rules needed beyond Code
text: The personal representative shall file all accountings using the official probate forms prescribed by the Register of Wills and shall comply with all Court of Chancery rules governing fiduciary accountings.

should_warn.reason: Probate forms, Register of Wills practice, and court rules are non-Code materials outside the database.

title: Delaware bill / session law boundary
text: The amendments to the Delaware trust code shall take effect as provided in Delaware Senate Bill 123 of the 152nd General Assembly.

title: Title beyond coverage boundary
text: The zoning variance shall be reviewed under 32 Del. C. § 101.

title: Case law coverage boundary
text: The directors' fiduciary duties shall be interpreted under Smith v. Van Gorkom, 488 A.2d 858 (Del. 1985), and In re Trados Inc. Shareholder Litigation, 73 A.3d 17 (Del. Ch. 2013).

title: HIPAA and federal health law boundary in trust context
text: The Trustee may obtain, use, and disclose protected health information of beneficiaries without regard to HIPAA, relying solely on Delaware trust law and fiduciary principles.

should_warn.reason: HIPAA is a federal law outside Delaware Code coverage; trust law alone does not override HIPAA.

title: Admin Code half coverage signal
text: A Delaware-licensed pharmacy shall comply with 24 Del. C. ch. 25 and 24 DE Admin. Code 2500.

title: ERISA preemption boundary in fiduciary context
text: The Trustee of a trust that holds assets of an employee benefit plan subject to ERISA shall administer those assets solely under Delaware trust law, without regard to ERISA fiduciary standards.

should_warn.reason: ERISA imposes federal fiduciary standards that may preempt state trust law; outside Delaware Code coverage.
